This audit is a guide for checking your completed and in-progress course work against the
requirements for this academic program. Efforts have been made to ensure its accuracy. However, it is
your responsibility to know the requirements of your academic program and to comply with them. The
results of this audit are not intended to override or modify existing program requirements. If you have
any questions about the accuracy of this report, please see your academic advisor, and check to
ensure that your student records on file with the Registrar are accurate.
